WEB.zh: 香港童軍總會網頁「地域及區」

zh.name: 帽
zh.rule: 男團員：深綠色黃間條鴨舌帽；女團員：深綠色圓形有邊帽（後面蝴蝶結）。帽冠已縫上布質帽章，帽徽朝前戴。宣誓後纔可佩戴。

en.name: Cap / hat
en.rule: Boys: dark green peaked cap with yellow piping. Girls: dark green round brimmed hat (bow at the back). The cloth cap badge is sewn on; wear it facing front. Worn only after investiture.

modelNote.zh: 帽章圖案取自《幼童軍支部訓練綱要》P.7 附圖（細圖放大，會有啲矇）。
modelNote.en: The cap badge artwork is from the Training Scheme p.7 figure (a small image enlarged, so slightly blurry).

zh.name: 恤衫
zh.rule: 杏色、短袖、兩胸袋、無褶、肩帶。

en.name: Shirt
en.rule: Beige, short sleeves, two chest pockets, no pleats, shoulder straps.

zh.name: 短褲／裙褲
zh.rule: 男團員：草青色短褲，兩斜袋、兩後袋、有褶。女團員：草青色裙褲，側袋、弓字褶。

en.name: Shorts / culottes
en.rule: Boys: grass-green shorts, two slanted pockets, two back pockets, pleated. Girls: grass-green culottes, side pockets, box pleat.

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.28 註：舊款短褲／長褲仍可穿著，直至破舊或有需要更換為止。
modelNote.en: Handbook p.28 note: the old shorts/trousers may still be worn until worn out.

en.name: Belt
en.rule: Brown, with the Scout badge buckle.

modelNote.zh: 皮帶扣只畫銀色方塊示意，冇畫徽號。
modelNote.en: The buckle is a plain silver block; the emblem is not drawn.

zh.name: 長襪
zh.rule: 深草青色、直坑紋、襪頭摺下。

en.name: Long socks
en.rule: Dark grass green, vertical ribs, turned-down tops.

zh.name: 皮鞋
zh.rule: 黑色、無花紋、縛帶、低筒、平底。

en.name: Shoes
en.rule: Black leather, plain, laced, low-cut, flat.

zh.name: 領巾
zh.rule: 旅巾（連顏色巾圈）。宣誓後纔可佩戴。

en.name: Neckerchief
en.rule: Group neckerchief with colour woggle. Worn only after investiture.

modelNote.zh: 旅巾顏色由各旅自定，模型可自選；預設跟附圖用綠色。
modelNote.en: Neckerchief colours are set by each Group; pick them in the model. Default is green as in the figures.

zh.name: 制服毛衣（可選）
zh.rule: 可因應個人體質或天氣情況穿著深草青色制服毛衣。領巾放喺毛衣外面；毛衣上只可以喺適當位置戴世界童軍會員章、香港章同旅章，其他章唔可以戴喺毛衣上。

en.name: Uniform jersey (optional)
en.rule: A dark grass-green uniform jersey may be worn for personal comfort or the weather. The neckerchief goes outside the jersey; only the World Membership Badge, Hong Kong Badge and Group Badge may be worn on it, in the appropriate places; no other badges.

modelNote.zh: 毛衣畫做長袖、坑紋、圓領（見到恤衫領）、膊頭淺色膊布（手冊 P.121–122 附圖）。徽章「或制服毛衣相同位置」：位置同恤衫一樣，向外移一個毛衣厚度。
modelNote.en: The jersey is drawn long-sleeved and ribbed, with a crew neck (shirt collar showing) and lighter shoulder patches (Handbook pp.121–122 figures). Badges go in “the same position on the uniform jersey”: the shirt positions, moved out by the jersey thickness.

zh.name: 世界童軍會員章
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋中央。
zh.quote: 童軍成員佩戴在制服恤衫……左胸袋中央位置，或制服毛衣相同位置。童軍成員宣誓後纔可佩戴。
zh.conditions: 宣誓後纔可佩戴。

en.name: World Membership Badge
en.place: Centre of the wearer's left chest pocket.
en.quote: Worn centred on the left chest pocket of the uniform shirt, or the same position on the uniform sweater. Worn only after investiture.
en.conditions: Worn only after investiture.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用直徑 4 cm，按 P.93 附圖同胸袋嘅比例。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 4 cm diameter, from its proportion to the pocket in the p.93 figure.

zh.name: 香港章
zh.place: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋上方 3 釐米，置中。
zh.quote: 幼童軍、童軍及深資童軍佩戴在制服恤衫左胸袋袋蓋上方三釐米中央位置，或制服毛衣相同位置。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章。

en.name: Hong Kong Badge
en.place: Centred 3 cm above the flap of the wearer's left chest pocket.
en.quote: Cub Scouts, Scouts and Venture Scouts wear it centred 3 cm above the left chest pocket flap of the uniform shirt, or the same position on the sweater.
en.conditions: Basic badge.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 4 × 5.6 cm（跟 P.93 圖案比例）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 4 × 5.6 cm (the p.93 artwork's proportions).

zh.name: 旅章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，肩膊縫線下方 2 釐米，置中。
zh.quote: 旅成員佩戴在制服恤衫……右袖肩膊位下方二釐米中央位置，或制服毛衣相同位置。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章；由所屬旅提供。

en.name: Group Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, centred 2 cm below the shoulder seam.
en.quote: Group members wear it centred 2 cm below the shoulder on the right sleeve of the uniform shirt, or the same position on the sweater.
en.conditions: Basic badge; supplied by the Group.

modelNote.zh: 手冊 P.94：新成立旅嘅旅章不小過 8.5 × 2 cm、不大過 10.5 × 2.5 cm；模型用 9 × 2.2 cm。圖案係手冊示例（2222 旅），各旅實際圖案唔同。
modelNote.en: Handbook p.94: a new Group's badge is between 8.5 × 2 cm and 10.5 × 2.5 cm; the model uses 9 × 2.2 cm. The artwork is the handbook example (2222th Group); each Group's badge differs.

zh.name: 地域章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，旅章下方 2 釐米；地域章在前（靠穿著者前面），區章在後，兩章相距 1 釐米。
zh.quote: 區幹部……及旅成員同時佩戴所屬地域章及區章在制服恤衫右袖香港肩章／旅章下方二釐米中央位置；地域章在前，區章在後，兩章相距一釐米。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章；跟所屬區嘅地域。

en.name: Region Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, 2 cm below the Group Badge; Region Badge in front (toward the wearer's front), District Badge behind, 1 cm apart.
en.quote: Group members wear both the Region and District Badges centred 2 cm below the Group Badge on the right sleeve; Region Badge in front, District Badge behind, 1 cm apart.
en.conditions: Basic badge; the Region of the member's District.

modelNote.zh: 圖案跟「區章」揀咗嘅區自動轉做所屬地域；未揀區就用手冊 P.168 示例色塊。總會總部屬下嘅區（例如銀禧區）網頁冇列地域章，模型唔顯示。手冊 P.168 同綱要 P.7 附圖都係前面（望住右袖時右手邊）地域章、後面區章，同 P.95 文字一致。只得一個（例如總會總部屬下嘅銀禧區冇地域章，或者熄咗其中一個）就放喺旅章下面中間（用戶指示）。
modelNote.en: The artwork follows the Region of the District picked under District Badge; with no District picked it uses the Handbook p.168 example block. Districts under AHQ (e.g. Silver Jubilee) have no Region Badge on the web page, so none is shown. The Handbook p.168 and Training Scheme p.7 figures both put the Region Badge in front (right-hand side when looking at the right sleeve) and the District Badge behind, matching the p.95 text. When only one of the pair is worn (e.g. Silver Jubilee District under AHQ has no Region Badge, or one is switched off) it goes centred below the Group Badge (user instruction).

zh.name: 區章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，旅章下方 2 釐米；喺地域章後面，相距 1 釐米。
zh.quote: 地域章在前，區章在後，兩章相距一釐米。地域章及區章……尺寸是 3.8 釐米（闊）× 5 釐米（高）。
zh.conditions: 基本徽章；揀返自己所屬嘅區。

en.name: District Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, 2 cm below the Group Badge; behind the Region Badge, 1 cm apart.
en.quote: Region Badge in front, District Badge behind, 1 cm apart. Region and District Badges are 3.8 cm wide × 5 cm high.
en.conditions: Basic badge; pick your own District.

modelNote.zh: 可以揀全港所有區（香港童軍總會網頁「地域及區」）；未揀區就用手冊示例色塊。只得一個（例如總會總部屬下嘅銀禧區冇地域章，或者熄咗其中一個）就放喺旅章下面中間（用戶指示）。
modelNote.en: Every District can be picked (SAHK “Regions and Districts” page); with none picked it uses the handbook example block. When only one of the pair is worn (e.g. Silver Jubilee District under AHQ has no Region Badge, or one is switched off) it goes centred below the Group Badge (user instruction).

zh.name: 優異旅團章
zh.place: 穿著者右袖，袖口縫線上方中央，為期一年。
zh.quote: 佩戴在制服恤衫右袖縫線上方中央位置，為期一年。有紅、紫和粉藍等三種顏色，每年輪流使用。
zh.conditions: 「優異旅團獎勵計劃」獲獎旅團嘅領袖、教練員及團員；為期一年。

en.name: Meritorious Group Badge
en.place: Wearer's right sleeve, centred above the sleeve-hem seam, for one year.
en.quote: Worn centred above the right sleeve seam of the uniform shirt, for one year. Comes in red, purple and light blue, used in turn each year.
en.conditions: Leaders, instructors and members of a Group awarded under the Meritorious Group Scheme; for one year.

modelNote.zh: 手冊冇寫尺寸；模型用 9 × 2 cm（P.159 圖案比例）。可以輸入年份：圖案底色同文字取自 P.159，只換年份數字；顏色每 3 年輪一次（1999 紅、2000 紫、2001 藍……，P.159 2016 藍、2017 紅、2018 紫吻合）。
modelNote.en: No size in the Handbook; the model uses 9 × 2 cm (p.159 artwork proportions). Type a year: the background and lettering come from p.159 and only the year digits change; the colour cycles every 3 years (1999 red, 2000 purple, 2001 blue…, matching 2016 blue, 2017 red, 2018 purple on p.159).

zh.name: 進度性獎章
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋中央（綱要 P.7 附圖）。
zh.quote: 進度性獎章：幼童軍體驗章、幼童軍歷奇章、幼童軍高級歷奇章、金紫荊獎章（綱要 P.7 附圖，佩戴喺右胸袋）。各進度性獎章應按階段完成。
zh.conditions: 考獲會員章後按階段考取（綱要 P.9、P.14–22）；只戴最新考獲嗰個。

en.name: Progress Award
en.place: Centre of the wearer's right chest pocket (Training Scheme p.7 figure).
en.quote: Progress awards: Cub Scout Discovery, Adventure, Advanced Adventure and Golden Bauhinia Awards (Training Scheme p.7 figure, worn on the right pocket). They are taken stage by stage.
en.conditions: Taken in stages after the Membership Badge (Training Scheme pp.9, 14–22); only the latest one is worn.

modelNote.zh: 圖案取自綱要 P.14、16、18、20；綱要冇寫尺寸，模型用 4 × 4 cm（按 P.7 附圖同胸袋嘅比例）。
modelNote.en: Artwork from Training Scheme pp.14, 16, 18, 20; no size given, the model uses 4 × 4 cm (from its proportion to the pocket in the p.7 figure).

zh.name: 童軍技能章（核心範疇章）
zh.place: 穿著者左袖上方，四個核心範疇章排成菱形，童軍技能章（綠色）喺最上面（綱要 P.7 附圖）。
zh.quote: 核心範疇章：童軍技能章（綠色）、關己愛人章（紅色）、國家與社區章（黃色）、童軍家庭章（紫色）；初級（銅邊）／中級（銀邊）／高級（金邊）。完成每項「核心範疇」，則可獲發該階段指定的「核心範疇」章。
zh.conditions: 歷奇章階段完成核心範疇得初級、高級歷奇章階段得中級、金紫荊獎章階段得高級（綱要 P.8、P.16–22）；只戴最高級嗰個。

en.name: Scout Skills Badge (core area badge)
en.place: Upper wearer's left sleeve; the four core area badges form a diamond, the Scout Skills Badge at the top (Training Scheme p.7 figure).
en.quote: Core area badges: Scout Skills (green), Caring (red), Nation and Community (yellow), Scout Family (purple); junior (bronze edge) / intermediate (silver edge) / senior (gold edge). Each completed core area earns that stage's core area badge.
en.conditions: Junior at the Adventure stage, intermediate at the Advanced Adventure stage, senior at the Golden Bauhinia stage (Training Scheme pp.8, 16–22); only the highest is worn.

modelNote.zh: 圖案取自綱要 P.16–22；綱要冇寫尺寸，模型用 2.3 × 2.6 cm 六角形，菱形位置固定（冇考獲嘅位留空）。
modelNote.en: Artwork from Training Scheme pp.16–22; no size given, the model uses a 2.3 × 2.6 cm hexagon in fixed diamond positions (empty when not earned).

zh.name: 關己愛人章（核心範疇章）
zh.place: 穿著者左袖上方，四個核心範疇章排成菱形，關己愛人章（紅色）喺中間前面（綱要 P.7 附圖）。
zh.quote: 核心範疇章：童軍技能章（綠色）、關己愛人章（紅色）、國家與社區章（黃色）、童軍家庭章（紫色）；初級（銅邊）／中級（銀邊）／高級（金邊）。完成每項「核心範疇」，則可獲發該階段指定的「核心範疇」章。

en.name: Caring Badge (core area badge)
en.place: Upper wearer's left sleeve; the four core area badges form a diamond, the Caring Badge at the middle, front (Training Scheme p.7 figure).
en.quote: Core area badges: Scout Skills (green), Caring (red), Nation and Community (yellow), Scout Family (purple); junior (bronze edge) / intermediate (silver edge) / senior (gold edge). Each completed core area earns that stage's core area badge.
en.conditions: Junior at the Adventure stage, intermediate at the Advanced Adventure stage, senior at the Golden Bauhinia stage (Training Scheme pp.8, 16–22); only the highest is worn.

modelNote.en: Artwork from Training Scheme pp.16–22; no size given, the model uses a 2.3 × 2.6 cm hexagon in fixed diamond positions (empty when not earned).

zh.place: 穿著者左袖上方，四個核心範疇章排成菱形，國家與社區章（黃色）喺中間後面（綱要 P.7 附圖）。
zh.quote: 核心範疇章：童軍技能章（綠色）、關己愛人章（紅色）、國家與社區章（黃色）、童軍家庭章（紫色）；初級（銅邊）／中級（銀邊）／高級（金邊）。完成每項「核心範疇」，則可獲發該階段指定的「核心範疇」章。

en.name: Nation and Community Badge (core area badge)
en.place: Upper wearer's left sleeve; the four core area badges form a diamond, the Nation and Community Badge at the middle, back (Training Scheme p.7 figure).
en.quote: Core area badges: Scout Skills (green), Caring (red), Nation and Community (yellow), Scout Family (purple); junior (bronze edge) / intermediate (silver edge) / senior (gold edge). Each completed core area earns that stage's core area badge.

zh.place: 穿著者左袖上方，四個核心範疇章排成菱形，童軍家庭章（紫色）喺最下面（綱要 P.7 附圖）。
zh.quote: 核心範疇章：童軍技能章（綠色）、關己愛人章（紅色）、國家與社區章（黃色）、童軍家庭章（紫色）；初級（銅邊）／中級（銀邊）／高級（金邊）。完成每項「核心範疇」，則可獲發該階段指定的「核心範疇」章。

zh.name: 童軍先修章
zh.place: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方，緊貼袋蓋（綱要 P.7 附圖）。
zh.quote: 幼童軍成員考獲童軍先修章後，即可佩戴於制服上，直至成為童軍後一年。
zh.conditions: 完成童軍先修章要求（認識童軍支部、參與兩次童軍團集會、新體驗）。

zh.name: 服務年星

en.conditions: One per full year of service after investiture; highest only.

zh.name: 小童軍服務年星（以前支部）

notAllowed.zh: 舊制幼童軍活動徽章：綱要 P.7 容許喺左袖左下方並列，直至晉升童軍團；模型唔示範舊制圖案。
notAllowed.en: Old-scheme Cub Scout activity badges may stay at the lower left of the left sleeve until moving up (Training Scheme p.7); the model does not show the old designs.

uninvested.zh: 未宣誓嘅青少年成員（小童軍除外）可穿著全套制服（不需扣上衣領鈕扣）；世界童軍會員章、制服帽、旅巾需待宣誓後纔可佩戴。
uninvested.en: Uninvested youth members (except Grasshoppers) may wear the full uniform (top button undone); the World Membership Badge, uniform cap and neckerchief are worn only after investiture.

conflicts.zh: 地域章／區章前後：手冊 P.95 文字「地域章在前，區章在後」；P.168 同綱要 P.7 附圖亦一致。模型照做。
conflicts.en: Region/District order: the Handbook p.95 text says Region in front, District behind; the p.168 and Training Scheme p.7 figures agree. The model follows this.

conflicts.zh: 長襪：手冊 P.28 寫「深草青色」；綱要 P.6–7 寫「深草青色、直坑紋、襪頭摺下」。模型跟綱要（較詳細，冇矛盾）。
conflicts.en: Socks: Handbook p.28 says dark grass green; the Training Scheme pp.6–7 adds vertical ribs and turned-down tops. The model follows the more detailed scheme (no conflict).

conflicts.zh: 隊長／副隊長章：手冊 P.132 寫喺右袖縫線上方 3 cm；2026 年 8 月版綱要 P.7 附圖改喺左胸袋會員章下面。綱要較新，模型跟綱要（用戶指示：綱要同手冊唔同就跟綱要）。
conflicts.en: Sixer/Second Badge: Handbook p.132 puts it 3 cm above the right sleeve seam; the August 2026 Training Scheme p.7 figure moves it below the Membership Badge on the left pocket. The scheme is newer and is followed (user instruction: where they differ the Training Scheme wins).

artCredit.zh: 徽章圖案取自香港童軍總會《儀容與制服手冊》P.25、P.92–93、P.129、P.132、P.138、P.155、P.159、P.168、《幼童軍支部訓練綱要》P.7、P.14–70（進度性獎章、核心範疇章、活動徽章、宗教章、童軍先修章、積極公民獎章） 及香港童軍總會網頁「地域及區」，版權屬香港童軍總會。旅章係手冊示例圖案；區章、地域章可以揀返自己嘅區。
artCredit.en: Badge artwork is from the Scout Association of Hong Kong Uniform Handbook (pp.25, 92–93, 129, 132, 138, 155, 159, 168), the Cub Scout Section Training Scheme (p.7 and pp.14–70: progress awards, core area, activity, Religious, Scout Link and Active Citizen badges) and the SAHK “Regions and Districts” page; copyright the Scout Association of Hong Kong. The Group Badge is the handbook example; pick your own District to get the right District and Region Badges.

pocketR.zh: 穿著者右胸袋袋蓋上方：童軍先修章緊貼袋蓋；宗教章／公教章、紀念章喺上面（綱要 P.7 附圖），兩個並排時宗教章／公教章喺內側。
pocketR.en: Above the wearer's right pocket flap: the Scout Link Badge on the flap; the Religious/Catholic Badge and the Commemorative Badge above it (Training Scheme p.7 figure), the Religious/Catholic Badge on the inner side when both are worn.

pocketL.zh: 穿著者左胸袋袋蓋上方（緊貼袋蓋）：服務年星；有小童軍服務年星就並排喺外側（手冊 P.130；綱要 P.7 附圖）。
pocketL.en: On top of the wearer's left pocket flap: the Service Star, with a Grasshopper Service Star beside it towards the outside (Handbook p.130; Training Scheme p.7 figure).

sleeveR.zh: 穿著者右袖、地域章／區章下面一行：世界童軍組織系列同「積極公民」獎章系列，最多合共四個（綱要 P.7 附圖）。四個格位固定（由前面排起），只係放咩同放幾多個唔同，唔會因為得一個就置中（用戶指示）。
sleeveR.en: Wearer's right sleeve, one row below the Region/District Badges: WOSM series and Active Citizen series, at most four in total (Training Scheme p.7 figure). The four positions are fixed (filled from the front); only what goes in them and how many change — a single badge is not centred (user instruction).

activityL.zh: 穿著者左袖下方：幼童軍活動徽章（六角形）由袖口縫線上面排起，一行四個、上一行三個，咬合排列（綱要 P.7 附圖）；模型由前面排起，排到核心範疇章下面為止（最多 11 個）。
activityL.en: Lower wearer's left sleeve: the hexagonal Cub Scout activity badges sit just above the cuff seam, four in a row with three interlocking above (Training Scheme p.7 figure); the model fills from the front and stops below the core area badges (at most 11).
